newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF offers 120 bln yen 0.7 pct two-yr notes. [CORRECTED 05:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF offers 120 bln yen 0.7 pct two-yr notes. [CORRECTED 05:05 GMT]

text.p: The Ministry of Finance said on Thursday it was offering 120 billion yen worth of 0.7 percent two-year government notes through a price competitive auction.
The auction will close at 0300 GMT and the results will be announced at 0530 GMT.
The issue date will be April 21, 1997, and maturity date will be April 20, 1999. (Corrects issue date from April 2 1997 and maturity date from April 2, 1999)
